title: Compass governance/guardrails.yml
description: The machine-readable guardrail definitions. The human-readable companion is guardrails.reference.yml; guardrails.md is the prose explanation. NOTE: JSON Schema cannot express the integrity rule that every guardrail's `checks` must also be implemented in the CLI's CHECK_FNS - `compass policy lint`'s built-in linter enforces that, and `compass check` fails on it at run time.

checks.description: The named mechanical checks. Each key is a check name a guardrail can reference.

evidence_types.description: The kinds of evidence a gate can be cleared with.

gate_evidence_requirements.description: gate id -> the list of evidence types that gate will accept. A gate not listed accepts any type.

spike_guardrails.description: Guardrails that apply ONLY on a spike. compass check runs these instead of the defaults when the delivery approach is spike.

project.description: Project-added guardrails. Same shape as a default. Each MUST reference a `checks` name that the CLI implements.

checks.description: Named checks (declared under `checks:` AND implemented in the CLI). A guardrail with no checks is a strategy.

applies_when.description: An optional `when` condition; the guardrail is only checked when it matches the issue's assessment.

params.description: Optional parameters for a parameterised check.
